description: Use when a user is planning or about to take a trip to Vietnam and you need to know whether it works as planned. Call it once, as the last step of itinerary planning, with nationality, dates and the places on the route. Returns one overall verdict plus flags for: visa exemption and stay length, whether the entry gate accepts e-visas, public holidays in the dates (Tet), recorded boat suspensions for Ha Long and the islands, official storm/flood bulletins (only when the trip is within 7 days), capped experiences (Son Doong) and motorbike licence rules (Ha Giang). Every item carries a source link and checked date. Does not search flights, hotels or tours.

entry_port.description: Airport, land border gate or sea port of entry, e.g. "Moc Bai" or "Noi Bai"

nationality.description: Passport country: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (DE) or English name

places.description: Places on the route, e.g. ["Ha Long", "Ha Giang", "Con Dao"]. Max 10.

name: check_vietnam_trip

error.description: Present only when the input was invalid

title: Vietnam trip feasibility check
